actual_capacity_observation.basis: f_bavail for every UID, including root

limits: This is a typed record schema and a synthetic harness, not a live Torch capture/restore adapter, learning kernel replay, registration or scientific execution.

Opaque Torch/Python/NumPy/named RNG record serialization does not certify that a live runtime will accept or install those states. The synthetic Torch RNG bytes are deliberately not a real live RNG snapshot.
Array restore uses separate contiguous copies; live shared-storage/alias semantics and runtime settings require a separately reviewed actual adapter.
The caller must hold a trusted environment identity independently; computing the expected identity from the same untrusted record establishes no provenance.
Monotone counters check supplied values and detect regression; they do not independently meter real model work or enforce full global resource budgets.
All nine real candidate artifact shape and metadata bounds remain unknown. shape_bound_verified is an external declaration that needs real independent evidence; a sample alone is not that proof.

510 MiB archive cap is a reserved prospective writer constraint, not an implemented archive writer or a packing-fit guarantee. Single scientific writer, bounded partial writes/receipts and counted retries are assumptions that the future runner must enforce.

save serializes in memory before exclusive disk write. The cap bounds the output file, not total peak resident memory. No streaming-memory or power-loss-complete directory durability claim is established.
Failure state is retained in memory by the synthetic harness; a future durable runner must bound and preserve adverse records without deleting prior evidence.
No model calls, head fits, holdout access, training microsteps, Rust builds, dependency downloads or raw uploads were performed by this independent review.
Original V5 scientific FAIL and no-admission remain unchanged. No new research registration/execution or product qualification is granted.
verified_scope: Typed scalar bits, tuple/list and integer/string key distinctions, array dtype/shape/literal bytes round-trip; big-endian arrays verified independently.

Caller-held whole-envelope identity, per-array hashes, complete unique references and canonical reserialization reject altered payload, duplicate references, unused arrays and noncanonical metadata even with a recomputed outer identity.

Shared encoder/measure/decoder limits enforce 4096 arrays and 1 MiB metadata. loads/save caps require exact nonnegative integers. Actual sample reads check regular file and size before a bounded cap+1 read.

Declared CPU parameter/buffer inventory/layout, requires_grad, module modes and named RNG inventory are bound to a separately held immutable environment identity. SGD name mapping is bijective; gradients preserve None separately from zero.
All 24 synthetic action permutations produce identical per-action records. Generator and mutable list action inputs are frozen before execution and exact integer IDs are required.

External work counters are not restored with branch state; callback exceptions retain completed branches, failed state and before/after costs, including an explicit additional integrity error when counters regress.
Actual sizing basis reads a real serialized sample, records its full SHA and exact byte count and verifies literal round-trip; boolean or float asserted sizes/counts are rejected.
Real BUDGET_PLAN leaves all nine required artifact bounds unknown; no synthetic sample is substituted. Unknown totals remain null and capacity fails closed.
Disk gate uses f_bavail for all UIDs, sufficient inodes and 2 GiB minimum plus calculated reserve. f_bfree is only observational. Research start stays false even in hypothetical capacity-pass cases.
